units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 106:39">Targ. Ps. CVI, 39</cite> <he>טְמִיאוּ</he> (some ed. incorr. <he>טַמִּי׳</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Numbers 12:12">Targ. Y. II, Num. XII, 12</cite>.—
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Micah 2:10">Targ. Mic. II, 10</cite> <he>בדיל לטַמָּיוּתָהּ</he> ed. Lag. (ed. <he>בדיל ט׳</he> corr. acc.) in order to defile her.—
<cite ref="Chullin 3a">Ḥull. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>לטַמְּיֵיה וטַמִּיתֵיה לבשר …</he> the person will make the knife unclean and then the knife will make the flesh unclean.
Pes. 79ᵃ דבשר הוא דמְטַמְּיָא ליה וכ׳ which affects only the flesh, but not the person. (Ms. M. דמִיטַּמֵּי … מִיטַּמְּאֵי, Ithpe.).
<cite ref="Pesachim 67b:1">Ib. 67ᵇ</cite> <he>טַמּוּיֵי מְטַמֵּי</he> makes unclean; a. fr.
